The frontend process (PID 14677, run-executor.js) is still running. I need to terminate it (this is the angular dev server via nx). The reason pkill ended up killing my own shell was that the shell's command line contained the pattern string. Let me terminate PID 14677 individually.

Also, I'll start the devcontainer service. Caddy is already up (but it still has the old environment variable BACKEND_HOST=devcontainer:5000? Wait — in the previous dev-fixed.yml, caddy's env was host.docker.internal:5000/4201, and after that I rewrote the file to devcontainer:5000/4201, but caddy is still running with the old config/environment variables). I need to recreate caddy.

Let me terminate PID 14677, and then start the devcontainer and recreate caddy.
